def test_authenticated_controlled_protocol():
        """Signed controlled runs enforce order, identity, timing, probes and failure cleanup."""
        tool_dir = Path("/opt/control/bin")
        for name in (
            "ld.bfd",
            "ld.bfd-alt",
            "ld.gold",
            "ld.gold-alt",
            "ld.gold-helper",
            "ld.gold-spoof",
            "ld.lld",
            "ld.lld-alt",
            "ld.lld2",
            "ld.mold",
            "ld.mold-alt",

            assert invoked_path.is_symlink()
